About Super Engineering

Engineering degrees built around making.

Chips, devices, machines and factories increasingly sense, decide and act. This is Physical AI. We want more people in India to know how to build it.

Book a campus visit

On this page

  • Why we started
  • What we believe
  • How we work

Make in India starts with people who can make

India needs engineers who can design, build and manufacture, and managers who can take those products to market. Super Engineering brings the two together through work on practical problems.

We started with a simple idea. Give students time and tools to build every semester, and they can leave with a body of work that shows what they know.

What we believe

Learn engineering by building

Theory matters when you have a circuit, device or model to make work. Practical projects give students a reason to go deeper.

Give each student the chance to prove it

Students build in teams and demonstrate key skills individually. Every pass becomes part of their Engineering Passport.

Teach students to work with AI

Use AI to help build and test projects. Check the results and be able to explain how they work.

Make the work visible

Students can show their designs, code and build videos. Partners can review the curriculum and the standards students are expected to meet.

For those who want the detail

Our long-term ambition is to educate 100,000 engineers who can build. The same projects, kits, reference designs and assessment standards are designed to work across participating campuses.

Super Engineering is designed to act as an academic delivery partner. Ask admissions to confirm the awarding university, approved degree names and campus information for your programme.
